name: Uz
overview: The name Uz appears in Scripture both as a personal name and as a geographical location. Uz is identified as a son of Aram (Genesis 10:23; 1 Chronicles 1:17), a son of Dishan (Genesis 36:28; 1 Chronicles 1:42), and as a son of Nahor, where he is called Huz in some translations (Genesis 22:21). Additionally, Uz is known as the land where the godly man Job lived, described as perfect, upright, and fearing God (Job 1:1). While the exact location of the country of Uz remains unknown, its biblical significance is highlighted through its connection to Job and the genealogical lines in Scripture.
